explanation.fa: برای گفتن نام، I am یا my name is را به کار ببر. I have یعنی «دارم»؛ پس از آن چیزی را که داری بگو: a big family. با you از are استفاده می‌کنیم.
explanation.en: Use I am or my name is for a name. I have means that something belongs to you or is part of your life: a big family. Use are with you.

example.text: Hello, my name is Hamid, I have a big family.

translation.fa: سلام، اسم من حمید است؛ خانوادهٔ پرجمعیتی دارم.
translation.en: Hello, my name is Hamid, I have a big family.

takeaway.en: Use I have to say what you have.

explanation.fa: How many people ...? یعنی «چند نفر ...؟». برای پاسخ، There are و تعداد را بگو. people خودش چند نفر را می‌رساند؛ peoples نمی‌گوییم. children هم یعنی چند فرزند.
explanation.en: How many people ...? asks for a number of people. Answer with There are and a number. People already means more than one person here. Children means more than one child.

example.text: There are eight people, my parents and six children.

translation.fa: هشت نفریم: پدر و مادرم و شش فرزند.
translation.en: There are eight people, my parents and six children.

takeaway.fa: How many تعداد را می‌پرسد؛ There are تعداد را معرفی می‌کند.
takeaway.en: How many asks the number; There are introduces it.

explanation.fa: a big family یعنی خانوادهٔ پرجمعیت؛ big پیش از family می‌آید. must be very lively یعنی «حتماً خیلی پرجنب‌وجوش است». اینجا must دستور نیست؛ سحر از شنیدن شش فرزند چنین حدسی می‌زند.
explanation.en: In a big family, big comes before family. Must be very lively means that Sahar thinks the home is very active. Must here is a confident guess, not an order.

example.text: Six children, that must be very lively at home.

translation.fa: شش فرزند! حتماً خانه خیلی پرجنب‌وجوش است.
translation.en: Six children, that must be very lively at home.

takeaway.fa: must be در این جمله یعنی «حتماً هست».
takeaway.en: Must be here means I feel sure it is.

rows.en: A guess based on family size

explanation.fa: always یعنی همیشه و پیش از have می‌آید. enjoy یعنی لذت بردن. someone to talk and play with را یک تکه یاد بگیر: «کسی که با او حرف بزنیم و بازی کنیم». with در پایان یعنی با همان شخص.
explanation.en: Always means every time and comes before have here. Enjoy means like and take pleasure in. Learn someone to talk and play with as a whole: a person for talking and playing together.

example.text: It is, and we always have someone to talk and play with.

translation.fa: همین‌طور است؛ همیشه کسی را داریم که با او حرف بزنیم و بازی کنیم.
translation.en: It is, and we always have someone to talk and play with.

takeaway.fa: عبارت بلند را به دو کار آشنا تقسیم کن: talk و play.
takeaway.en: Break the phrase into two familiar actions: talk and play.

rows.fa: برای حرف زدن و بازی با او

title.fa: پاسخ کوتاه و اشاره به حرف قبل

explanation.fa: It is یعنی «همین‌طور است»؛ حمید حرف سحر دربارهٔ شلوغی خانه را تأیید می‌کند. That sounds wonderful هم واکنش به حرف قبلی است. which is nice too یعنی «که این هم خوب است» و به گرفتن توجه اشاره دارد؛ فعلاً آن را یک عبارت آماده یاد بگیر.
explanation.en: It is agrees with the description of a lively home. That sounds wonderful reacts to the earlier words. Which is nice too comments on getting attention; learn it as a useful phrase here.

example.text: I am sure you get all the attention, which is nice too.

translation.fa: مطمئنم همهٔ توجه نصیب تو می‌شود؛ این هم خوب است.
translation.en: I am sure you get all the attention, which is nice too.
